summary.zh: 偏多訊號 11 檔、危險訊號 4 檔，半導體強彈，多檔出現超賣反彈與突破 200 日線

text.en: Over 5 years, 20 days after an oversold rebound averaged 3.16% vs a 1.73% baseline; the program rates it informative

text.en: After a 200-day MA breakout or a MACD death cross, the 20-day average was 1.35% and 1.48%, about the same as usual

summary.en: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia dominated headlines and revived the AI trade; the Fed's Williams hinted rates may rise

text.en: CNBC: New York Fed's John Williams indicated higher interest rates are likely 'over time' to address inflation

text.en: Reuters: The US imposed sanctions on dozens linked to Iran's shadow banking networks

text.en: CNBC: A look at where AMD shares stand after Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
